description: Declarative step graph for the Personalized Learning Assistant workflow. Single source of truth: the coordinator reads it to build the execution plan, and the hooks read it to enforce artifact ownership and to cascade staleness. Steps sharing a group number have no dependency on each other and MUST be dispatched in parallel.

requirements-formalizer.purpose: Turn the raw request plus clarifying Q&A into confirmed, structured requirements.

knowledge-assessor.mode_rule: light when requirements.current_level == 'absolute beginner' (skip the diagnostic, assert a zero baseline); otherwise full.
knowledge-assessor.purpose: Establish what the learner already knows and place them on a level scale.

curriculum-architect.purpose: Decompose the goal into ordered modules with objectives and prerequisites.

curator.purpose: Source concrete, verifiable learning resources for every module. Exactly one variant runs per run.

exercise-designer.purpose: Design hands-on practice per module. Keyed to module objectives, not to specific resources, so it can run in parallel with the curator.

assessment-designer.skip_rule: Skip when requirements.wants_assessments == false. Gate G5 then drops its assessment clause.
assessment-designer.purpose: Design checkpoints, self-tests and rubrics per module.

schedule-planner.purpose: Lay modules, resources and exercises onto a week-by-week calendar within the stated weekly budget.

effort-budget-aggregator.purpose: Total up hours and money across every module and resource.

validator.purpose: Run every quality gate in gates.md and report pass/fail with findings and the owning step.

learning-path-builder.purpose: Synthesis subagent. Merge validated artifacts into one coherent learner-facing document.

html-builder.purpose: Render the approved Markdown as a standalone HTML guide.
